# 📁 Project Documentation (`milestones/`)

The `milestones\` folder contains reports of the purpose and expected outcome of
a project step. Milestone reports are short project management captions that
answer:

    “What is this milestone for, and what will be completed when it’s done?”

Reports in the `milestones` folder include discussion of the goal or question
being answered, key tasks or processes, expected outputs, and dependencies or
what the milestone builds on.

---

## 🔖 Structure Overview

```{r table_of_scripts,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,results='asis'}

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)

script_index <- tribble(
  ~`Subfolder / File`, ~Purpose,
  "milestone_00_project_structure_refactor", "Documents major project refactor to improve clarity, modularity, and reproducibility using milestones and standard naming conventions. Tracks structured covariate metadata development", "milestone_01_download_prepare_covariates", "Documents covariate acquisition, validation, and preparation", "milestone_02_documentation", "Documents embedding documentation within analysis folders and formalizing metadata management"
)

kbl(script_index, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = "Script Index") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down")) %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "12.0cm")

```
